why: Issue #763 requires that a new production stylesheet cannot be left outside the check. public/ is copied into the build as-is (privacy.html carries a <style> block today), so a discovery that walks only src/ silently stops checking it.
killedBy: css integrity: the shipped stylesheets every shipped stylesheet parses as written
css integrity: the shipped stylesheets finds a stylesheet added anywhere under src/ or public/, or as a root page, without a list to update
